title: Didaske
shortDescription: Read and compare Bible passages and explore the Greek words in context.
fullDescription:
Read a chapter and select a verse to compare the available Polish, English and Greek editions. Open a publisher’s footnote where its marker appears in the text. Keep it beside the passage as you continue reading.

Select a Greek word to see its attested meanings, pronunciation and grammar. Search the local collection or read the Greek letters of Ignatius of Antioch. Choose Polish or English for the interface independently of the text you are reading.
releaseNotes: Compare verses, open TNP footnotes and look up Greek forms in context.
